title: com.cuvara.vfx capture statistics (stats.json), lint mirror
description: Mirror of the UnityVFX package schema Schemas~/vfx-capture.schema.json (cuvara.vfx-capture/1, Documentation~/CAPTURE.md), restricted to the fields scripts/vfx/vfx_style.py lint and the vfx quality plugin read. Every field named here exists in the package schema with the same name and type; the package schema is the source of truth and holds more fields (frames, contact_sheet, bounds, resolution, ...), so this mirror allows additional properties. The capture records no platform or budget field: budgets come from the vfx-style profile.

effect.description: project path of the captured .prefab or .vfx

recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the <name>.vfxrecipe.json next to the effect's .vfx, or null when there is none; lint compares it with the recipe file

seed.description: VisualEffect.startSeed; compared with the profile's capture.seed

duration_seconds.description: simulated time at which the effect ended; null when it did not end by max_seconds or never had a particle

peak.description: largest alive count at any sample or probe; graded against each platform's max_alive_particles

systems.description: one entry per particle system; capacity is graded against the budgets and peak against capacity

characters.description: added 2026-11-27, optional: the characters the capture placed (inputs character, target_count, target_spacing, source_socket, target_socket); null when the capture placed none

character.description: the character input: placeholder, or the project path of the requested prefab

placed.description: what was placed: placeholder (the code-built VfxMannequin), or the project path of the prefab; placeholder when the requested prefab does not exist

binders.description: added 2026-11-27, optional: one entry per ChainLightningBinder the capture bound to the characters (empty when none); source and targets are the values the graph holds after binding, null or shorter when the graph does not expose the property

name.description: hierarchy path of the binder's object in the effect

added.description: true when the capture added the binder to a .vfx effect whose graph exposes the binder's default properties

graph_hop_count.description: the hop count property read back from the graph, or null when not exposed

position.description: world position of the character's root (its feet)

socket.description: world position of the bound socket (source_socket for the caster, target_socket for a target), or of the root when socket_found is false

in_frame.description: true when the world bounds of the character's renderers lie inside the camera's frame
